name: linux-vs-unix
description: Complete icon set for Linux vs Unix Animation — history/concept icons + real brand/distro logos (Unix family, Linux family, Windows). Style: minimalist grayscale/monochrome line-art, TRANSPARENT background (not solid gray) so icons blend into the app's dark canvas.

style_guide.palette: grayscale monochrome (black/white/gray only) — keep all icons visually consistent, including brand logos which should be redrawn in the same flat monochrome line-art style rather than full-color
style_guide.notes: Brand/distro logos should follow each brand's real silhouette/shape as closely as possible (e.g. Ubuntu's circle-of-friends, Debian's swirl, Arch's mountain-A, Fedora's infinity mark, Android's robot head, Windows' four-pane flag, Apple's bitten apple, FreeBSD's Beastie daemon) — just rendered in monochrome instead of the original brand colors, to match the rest of the icon set. The 'Linus' icon stays a stylized generic programmer avatar (glasses + laptop), not a photorealistic likeness of a real person.

real_person_photos_note: Ken Thompson, Dennis Ritchie, and Linus Torvalds are real named people — AI image generation should NOT be used to fabricate their likeness (not accurate, and not appropriate to generate via AI). Instead, source real Creative-Commons-licensed photos (e.g. from Wikipedia) and save them manually as: kt-photo.png (Ken Thompson), dr-photo.png (Dennis Ritchie), linus-photo.png (Linus Torvalds). The code already has graceful fallback to the current initials-circle / stylized-avatar look if these files are absent, so dropping them in later 'just works'.
next_steps: 1. Run batch-5 and batch-6 prompts through your local icon-generation pipeline (batch-1..4 already generated and wired).
2. Slice each grid PNG into individual icon files, named by 'id' (e.g. bell-labs-v2.png, redhat.png, manjaro.png).
4. (Optional, manual) Source real CC-licensed photos for Ken Thompson, Dennis Ritchie, Linus Torvalds — save as kt-photo.png, dr-photo.png, linus-photo.png. See 'real_person_photos_note' above.
5. Tell Claude when done — loader.js / Animation-history.jsx will be updated to wire in the new files (with safe fallbacks for anything still missing).
